# Qestimation

> Qestimation is an Australian construction estimating company. We prepare quantity takeoffs, bid estimates, budget estimates and on-site cost controls for developers, general contractors, subcontractors and architects. Accuracy is typically within 1% of final construction cost. Free quotes are returned within 24 hours.

## Key facts
- Services: cost estimation, material/quantity takeoff, budget estimating, cost controls
- Trades covered: site work, concrete, masonry, metals, lumber/framing, drywall, flooring, painting, exterior finishes, plumbing, electrical
- Deliverables: executive takeoff summary, colour-coded marked plans, 3D cut/fill grading models, priced Excel estimate
- Turnaround: quote in 24 h; most takeoffs in 2–5 business days
- Location: Brisbane, QLD, Australia (serving all of Australia)
- Contact: 07 3000 0000 · estimates@qestimation.com
- Refunds: no refunds, exchanges/revisions only; no card details are ever collected

- [What Is a Quantity Takeoff? A Plain-English Guide for Builders](https://qestimation.com/blog-what-is-a-quantity-takeoff.html): A quantity takeoff is the measured list of materials and labour items a project needs, taken directly from the drawings. It is the foundation of every reliable construction estimate.
- [How Much Does a Construction Estimate Cost in Australia?](https://qestimation.com/blog-construction-estimate-cost-australia.html): Outsourced construction estimates in Australia typically cost between a few hundred dollars for a single-trade takeoff and a low four-figure sum for a full commercial bid, far less than the margin lost on one mispriced tender.
- [Bid Estimate vs Budget Estimate: Which One Does Your Project Need?](https://qestimation.com/blog-bid-estimate-vs-budget-estimate.html): A budget estimate forecasts cost from early design to test feasibility, usually within 10 to 20 percent. A bid estimate is a fully measured, priced tender figure accurate to a few percent.
- [How to Win More Construction Tenders Without Cutting Your Margin](https://qestimation.com/blog-win-more-construction-tenders.html): Contractors win more tenders by pricing from accurate quantities, comparing subcontractors line by line, pricing risk explicitly and presenting a bid the client can trust, not by shaving margin.
- [Concrete Takeoff Guide: Measuring Slabs, Footings and Reinforcement Correctly](https://qestimation.com/blog-concrete-takeoff-guide.html): A concrete takeoff measures concrete volume by element and grade, reinforcement by mesh sheets and bar tonnage, formwork by face area, and adds pumping, finishing and curing items that are easy to miss.
- [Outsourcing Construction Estimating: Pros, Cons and How to Choose a Provider](https://qestimation.com/blog-outsourcing-construction-estimating.html): Outsourcing estimating gives builders fixed per-project costs, fast turnaround and specialist accuracy, at the cost of some control. Choosing a provider that shows its working closes that gap.


## FAQ
- **What is a construction cost estimate?** A construction cost estimate is a detailed forecast of what a building project will cost, covering materials, labour, equipment, overheads and contingencies. Qestimation prepares conceptual, bid and budget estimates so developers and contractors know the real number before committing.
- **How accurate are Qestimation estimates?** Our estimates are typically within 1% of final construction costs. We price every item from current supplier and subcontractor rates for the project’s location and cross-check quantities with colour-coded marked plans.
- **How fast can I get a quote or estimate?** A free quote is usually returned within 24 hours of receiving your drawings. Most trade takeoffs are delivered in 2–5 business days depending on project size, and rush turnaround is available.
- **Which file formats can I send?** We accept PDF, DWG, DXF, Revit/BIM exports, scanned plans and photos. Upload them through the quote form or email them to our estimating team.
- **Who uses Qestimation?** Developers, general contractors, subcontractors, architects, quantity surveyors and owner-builders across Australia use Qestimation for quantity takeoffs, bid estimates, budget estimates and on-site cost control.
- **What trades do you estimate?** Site work, concrete, masonry, structural and miscellaneous metals, lumber and framing, drywall, flooring, painting, exterior finishes, plumbing, electrical, HVAC and more. See our work samples for real examples.
- **Do you offer refunds?** We do not issue refunds; instead we offer exchanges and revisions until the deliverable meets the agreed scope. Full details are on our Refund Policy page.
